Attachments: I attached a short one-pager summarizing audit log formats and an editable VSQ template for your security team.

If that looks right, we can schedule the technical call and get the VSQ over to procurement.

Thanks — talk soon.

Subject: BeamHealth sample export + schema (internal prep)

Hannah / Aditya — draft of what we'll share with BeamHealth: 

1) Export format and delivery
- Daily scheduled exports: NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON), gzipped (.ndjson.gz), uploaded to customer-provided S3 bucket via role-based upload.
- Ad-hoc extracts: time-range query (ISO timestamps) delivered as signed HTTPS download (7-day pre-signed link).

2) Schema highlights (sample fields we will include)
- event_id, event_type, timestamp (RFC3339), user_id, actor_role, ip_address, request_path, response_code, request_id, model_id, token_count, checksum_sha256
- metadata: retention_policy, export_batch_id, export_created_by

3) Immutability & forensic assurances
- Internal append-only event store with signed checksums; exports are write-once files.
- We persist audit trail of export actions (who requested, who exported, where delivered) and can provide signed manifest for auditor verification.

4) Retention and deletion
- Configurable retention per log type. By default API logs 90d, admin logs 2 years. Can be extended to meet legal/contractual (up to 7 years).
- Deletion APIs provide tombstones; we keep export manifests beyond deletion windows to satisfy auditability (separate retention policy).

5) Access controls / encryption
- Exports encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (SSE-S3/SSE-KMS based on customer preference).
- Role-based access controls for export requests; RBAC mapped to customer SSO via SCIM/SAML.

6) Sample files and link
- Sample NDJSON export (synthetic events): https://redwood.app/share/beamhealth-audit-samples
- Short spec PDF included in the shared folder for auditors.

If BeamHealth wants, we can also provide a short manifest that auditors can use to verify checksums.

Olga Petrov
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
